parameters.parameter: System should have ultrasonic energy as well as Advance RF Energy/Bipolar energy device for cutting and tissue dissection and vessel sealing
Switch and control systems provided
Type of activation available for operating ultrasonic energy and/or RF energy system
Should have the ability to change the power level settings selections during the use
Type of Display
Touch Screen Display
Should have stand by mode to ensure safety
System should have onscreen warning display system for generator overheating, generator software upgrade,hand piece errors and instrument errors
Consumable compatibility with surgery type allowing simultaneous cutting and coagulation of tissues
Should be compatible with ultrasonic and advanced bipolar energy instruments which can simultaneously seal and transect vessels , large pedicles and vascular bundles with ultrasonic energy
Capacity of ultrasonic energy and advanced bipolar energy instruments for working with up to 7mm vessels
Frequency range of instruments ultrasonic device can power in KHZ
Number of power setting levels with power level display for ultrasonic energy instrument
Area of lateral thermal spread not to exceed
Movement of shaft rotation for compatible energy consumables available during surgical procedures in degrees
Instrument recognition system
Interface modality for allowance of software upgrades
Main cable with power socket of standard indian make to be provided
Compliance to Medical Device Rules (MDR) 2017 as amended till date
Availability of valid Medical Device license for the product issued from the competent authority defined under Drugs and Cosmetic Act 1940 and Rules made there under as amended till date
Submission of all necessary certifications, licenses and test reports to the buyer at the time of bid submission or along with supplies as per buyer requirement
Warranty in years (Option of comprehensive warranty is available through bidding only, which if opted will supersede normal warranty in the catalogue)

buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 2. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 3. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C MEDICAL DIRECTOR, DDU HOSPITAL . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of MEDICAL DIRECTOR, DDU HOSPITAL A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 6. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test

certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. ACCEPTANCE CERTIFICATE:- BIDDER MUST SUBMIT THE ACCEPTANCE DECLARATION ON ITS LETTE R HEAD THAT IT ACCEPTS ALL THE GTC AND ATC OF THE GEM BID. 2. IN CASE OF MANUFACTURER, FIRM MUST SUBMIT THE OEM DECLARATION ON ITS LETTER HEAD T HAT DECLARES THAT THE BIDDER IS ORIGINAL MANUFACTURER OR THE PRODUCT. 3. BIDDER MUST SUBMIT ONLY THE BID RELATED DOCUMENTS THAT ARE RELEVANT TO THE GEM BI D. 4. PRODUCT CATALOGUE / LITERATURE SHOULD BE SUBMITTED IN CASE CATALOGUE CONTAINS MO RE THAN ONE ITEM, PRODUCT QUOTED SHOULD BE HIGHLIGHTED AND SPECIFIED. 5. SHOULD PROVIDE THE DEMONSTRATION OF ITS PRODUCT IN THE CONCERNED DEPARTMENT OF DDU HOSPITAL. 6. SHOULD PROVIDE PRICE LIST OF ACCESSORIES / CONSUMABLE WHICH ARE N OT INCLUDED IN CMC. . 10. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre.
